item.title: Vehicle parking in cul de sac, 29th September
item.description:
I contacted the Gloucester Highways about this and have been directed back to Fix my street portal, therfore I will report again Vehicles are parking nose in on cul de sac at Castle Hill Drive Brockworth which contravenes road traffic act parking rules which reduces the turning circle in the cul de sac for refuse collection vehicles and large emergency vehicles, in fact I have witnessed refuse collection vehicles reversing the length of the street into the cul de sac as there is not enough room in the turning circle which is against the Health and Safety Executive guidance for driving refuse collection vehicles I suggest that double yellow lines should be painted to keep the cul de sac turning head clear and residents sent a letter to stop this parking practice

item.title: Dipped road surface from previous road works, 29th September
item.description:
A strip of previously dug up & filled in carriageway across both sides of 18 Albert Road, Cheltenham has dipped. It’s not noticeable when small vehicles drive over, but anything larger than a transit, and anything pulling a trailer makes a distinct thud sending, vibrations right through our property, number 18. Whilst watching the vehicles you can see their back tyres bounce. It has steadily got worse over the summer to the extent the windows, door and wardrobe doors on the first & second floors of our house actually shudder. Friday to Saturday we are woken every morning around 6 AM by heavy construction traffic clanging over the dip whilst driving to the School at the top of Albert Rd, then again at 6.30 AM by a bus/coach, unhindered by the lack of traffic that time in the morning they are able to travel a little faster, so the louder the thud & greater the vibration as they drive over the dip. We’ve tried sleeping in our back bedroom but worryingly the house shakes at the back too so there is no escaping it.. As you can appreciate we are concerned over the structural damage to our property from continuous vibrations throughout a long working day if the dip in road is not corrected and the surface made flat again. We look forward to hearing from you

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 22, Albert Road, Marle Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
